authorization.consent_handoff: user-approved redirect followed to the native localhost callback

limitations: The consent page required the already-approved redirect response to be followed to VS Code's localhost callback; VS Code itself received the authorization code, performed the PKCE exchange, created the refreshable session, restored it after restart, discovered the tools, and invoked the tool.

This certificate covers authenticated read-only discovery and gateway_echo execution. Mutating approval, revocation, tenant-isolation, cancellation, and replay behavior remain covered by gateway and bridge integration gates rather than this editor smoke certificate.

The sampled authorization request used 14 ms of Worker CPU, above the configured 10 ms Free-plan request budget; broader onboarding remains paused pending representative resampling or explicit paid-plan approval.
